title: 9 months, 6,000 commits, one developer: I'm building an open-world voxel action RPG with AI
author: Bingfongwill
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I'm a solo dev from Taiwan. Since February I've been making Fangjie: Shattered Altars, an open-world voxel action RPG, with AI doing a big part of the work.

It's not a small game: a new world every time you play, villages with their own people, four races and four classes with skill trees, nearly forty creatures you can tame and ride, bosses with full movesets, and online multiplayer with up to 48 players in one world. It runs on my own engine built on Three.js and WebGPU, not Unity or Godot.



How the work splits:

\- Claude Code writes most of the code. Over 6,000 commits so far.

\- Music is made with Suno (commercial license), and a lot of the art is AI assisted.

\- I decide what the game is: the classes, the skills, the bosses, the balance, and what looks right. I play it every day and send things back when they don't feel good.



The free demo has been on Steam since October, with the warrior and mage. Players spend about 1 hour 40 minutes in it on average. Wishlists are still small (around 520), so I'm learning marketing now, and this post is part of that.

The video is some warrior and mage skills in the open world. Every effect is made of cubes.

Demo: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5103920/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=social&utm\_campaign=aigamedev\_2026\_11](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5103920/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev_2026_11)

I'd really appreciate any feedback, on the game or on how I'm working with AI. Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
